subject: tr
title: TR.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 136 (ALT(FT)II-30). TR (transformation) is the subject; INFO-DY is the partner. From the subject: RT-ALGN (reality alignment), C-INFO (composite information) and AF-DT (affinity dictates). From RT-ALGN: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: PART (participation). From PART: DOC (documentation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From DOC: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From C-INFO: IST-F (isolated focus). From IST-F: MOT-DY. From AF-DT: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: INT (intention).
